summary: - **[key4hep/EDM4hep#528](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/528)** — Adds a per-hit `timeError` member to `TrackerHit3D`, `TrackerHitPlane`, `SenseWireHit` and the `TrackerHit` interface, mirroring the existing `eDep`/`eDepError` pair. This bumps the schema version and keeps the previous schema as `old_schemas/edm4hep_v6.yaml`, so producers and readers of tracker hits should expect the new field.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1690](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1690)** — Sensitive detectors now keep volume-exit state changes when a step is removed by the energy filter. Previously, short low-energy exit steps were dropped, the hit stayed open, and its position was averaged with the next sensor. That produced hits outside sensors, including spurious stripes at z=0 (k4geo#538).

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#124](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/124)** — Fixes the hit covariance orientation in `prepareTrackerHits` by rotating the u/v uncertainties into the ACTS surface frame instead of assigning them directly to loc0/loc1. In endcaps where the axes were swapped, good hits failed the CKF χ² cut, which caused holes and truncated or lost forward tracks. Barrel modules are unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#125](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/125)** — Adds an `InitialTrackError_QOverP` property to `CKFTrackingAlg` and `GNNTrackFinder`, an absolute q/p error added in quadrature to the existing relative term. With only the relative term, high-pT seeds had too small a momentum uncertainty for the CKF to correct, while raising the relative error pushed fake tracks to high pT.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/113)** — `TrackMerger` gains a significance-based matching criterion, which is now the default. Matching defaults are aligned with `ClonesAndSplitTracksFinder` in CLDConfig, so existing configurations will see different merging behaviour.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#112](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/112)** — `GenfitTrackFitter` now resets the process-global TGeoManager navigator to a canonical state before each fit. Without the reset, material assigned to points on geometry boundaries could depend on previously fitted tracks, making fit results depend on processing order.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#117](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/117)** — `VTXdigitizerDetailed` now reads sensor thickness from the sensitive volume rather than from the ZPlanarData/ZPetalData extensions. This lets the digitiser run on compound vertex detectors such as ALLEGRO, while CLD output is verified unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#116](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/116)** — `GGTFTrackFinder` gains an `EmbeddingCoordinates` property so it can use models trained with different embedding-space dimensions. Extra model output features are now ignored instead of crashing inference.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#66](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/66)** — `EDMToHepMCConverter` set particle energy to the mass and divided vertex time by c instead of multiplying; both are fixed. `FlatSmearVertex` used a time offset of dz/c instead of dz for beam-shifted events, which is also fixed.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#62](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/62)** — `HepMCToEDMConverter` now preserves HepMC particle ordering and includes vertex time. Feeding HepMC3 or EDM4hep input through ddsim now yields matching hit collections (partially addresses #61).

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#403](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/403)** — Adds conformal tracking with silicon hits to the ALLEGRO o1_v03 and o2_v01 digi+reco sequences and enables it in their tests. It depends on k4Reco#72 (keep tracks without an ECAL intersection) and on cylindrical calorimeter surface plugins for correct extrapolation.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1699](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1699)** — The calorimeter barrel and endcap surface plugins now accept `symmetry=0` to create cylindrical surfaces instead of only polyhedra. This is needed to extrapolate ALLEGRO tracks to the ECAL face.
